name: 16-Button Membrane Keypad
description: Like a bank vault keypad! 16 tactile keys multiplexed into 8 pins using row-column matrix scanning.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a bank vault keypad! 16 tactile keys multiplexed into 8 pins using row-column matrix scanning.
wiringGuidance: Connect Row pins R1-R4 (Green wires) to digital pins 9, 8, 7, 6. Connect Column pins C1-C4 (Green wires) to digital pins 5, 4, 3, 2.
commonMistakes: Reversing row and column ribbon connector pin order.
Attempting to read keys without enabling internal pull-ups or scanning row by row.

miniExperiment.title: Keypad Matrix Scanner
miniExperiment.circuit: Rows to pins 9-6, Cols to pins 5-2.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor logs exact row and column numbers as you tap keys on the membrane keypad.
